title: Subgroup measures and profinite rigidity in free groups
summary: Let $H$ be a finitely generated subgroup of a finitely generated group $F$. Restriction of a uniformly random homomorphism $F\to G$, with $G$ finite, defines a probability measure on $\mathrm{Hom}(H,G)$; for cyclic $H$ this is the usual word measure. We introduce marked and setwise notions of profinite rigidity for these subgroup measures. In a finitely generated LERF group, an isomorphism between finitely generated subgroups preserves all induced measures if and only if its profinite completion extends to an automorphism of the ambient profinite completion.
